visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, wearing stylish translucent frameless glasses and a beige knit sleeveless top, smiles warmly at the camera. She stands in an outdoor park during the golden hour, with soft, warm sunlight illuminating her face. In the background, green trees and a distant fence are visible under a clear blue sky. (2) The scene shifts to the woman leaning on a metal railing by a river at dusk. She is seen from a side perspective, wearing the same beige top and a white shoulder bag. The background features a calm river reflecting city lights and a vibrant twilight sky with purple and orange hues. (3) Transition to a studio setting where the woman speaks directly to the audience. She gestures with her hands, which have white nail polish. She holds a small, elegant pinkish-beige foundation bottle labeled MAQuillAGE. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows against a minimalist neutral grey wall behind her. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the back of her hand as a drop of pinkish liquid foundation is pumped from the bottle. Her fingers, adorned with a silver ring, spread the cream smoothly across her skin, demonstrating its high moisture and blendable texture under focused studio lighting. (5) The woman uses a professional black makeup brush to apply the product to her cheek with precise strokes. A split-screen comparison follows, showing her skin's texture Before with some redness and After with a smooth, glowing finish. High-definition close-ups emphasize the coverage of pores. (6) To demonstrate makeup longevity, she holds a smartphone displaying the time as 11:53, then transitions to a shot at 23:30 in an indoor setting. Her makeup remains intact and glowing. In the final scene, she is seen outdoors lying on a sunny lawn as a white dog on a leash strolls by in the background.
